newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Astra upgraded to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Astra upgraded to buy.

text.p: -- Robert Fleming said it had upgraded Argentina's Astra Cia Argentina de Petroleo SA to buy from long-term buy.

-- "In the third quarter of its fiscal year, Astra's earnings of $14.6 million were slightly below our $15.3 million estimate and well above third quarter 1995's earnings of $8.4 million," analysts Jose Costa Buck and Gonzalo Pangaro wrote in an analysis.
-- "This solid result can be traced to the company's respectable job of reducing costs, higher oil production and an increase in oil and gas prices."
-- They added, "We believe Astra to be one of the most attractive investment vehicles in Argentina's energy sector."
